findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Soda nozzle was observed to contain an accumulation of mold.  Discussed with PIC, corrected on site.  Ensure soda nozzle and gun is cleaned daily to prevent accumulation of mold and debris.

4-602.11: (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Chlorine test strips are available, but the facility uses quaternary ammonium as a sanitizer.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure the proper test strips are available to test the concentration of sanitizer.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The trim attaching the wall and mop sink has an accumulation of mold.  Discussed with PIC, adding caulk along the seams and trim will make the area non absorbent and easily cleanable.  Ensure the trim is sealed.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14  (P) Employee did not wash hands after eating/drinking/smoking. Food employee must practice good hygiene by properly washing hands when changing tasks. Reference 2-301.14.

Observed employee fill a beverage order after drinking personal drink/handling mail without washing hands first. Ensure hands are washed properly before handling customer orders.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114  (P) Chlorine sanitizer at 0 ppm. Provide 50ppm to 200ppm chlorine concentration (or quat) sanitizer bucket during hours of operation Reference 4-501.114.

No sanitizer solution made at time of inspection. All-purpose cleaner is not an approved sanitizer for food contact surfaces. Ensure properly concentrated quat or chlorine bucket/bottle available for use at all hours of operation.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text:
3-501.17  (Pf) Date marking is not on open half and half and juice. Food shall be clearly marked, at the time the original container is opened in a food establishment and if the food is held for more than 24 hours, to indicate the date or day by which the food shall be consumed on the premises, sold, or discarded, when held at a temperature of 41 deg F or less for a maximum of 7 days (not exceeding a manufacturer's use-by date).Reference 3-501.17.
Observed multiple liquids without date marking. Ensure items are labeled with the date it was opened and used/discarded after 7 days.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-102.11  (Pf) Working container of cleaner not properly labeled. Containers of toxic materials must be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material. Reference 7-102.11.
Large bottle of unidentified cleaner is not labeled. Ensure all mistakable liquids, powders, etc. are properly labeled.
findings.citation_text:
7-204.11  (P) bleach is not approved for use as a sanitizer. Chemical sanitizers must meet the requirements specified in 40 CFR 180.940, or meet the requirements as specified in 40 CFR 180.2020. Reference 7-204.11.
Bleach must have a label 1) EPA registration 2) use for food contact surfaces such as cutting boards, dishes, and utensils 3) directions for solution (x capfulls to make xppm concentration) 4)must be plain bleach (NO lemon fresh, orange, fresh scent)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on ceilings and walls of walk in cooler. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.
Observed residue of what appears to be mold on walls and cielings of walk-in cooler. Ensure coolers are serviced and/or cleaned before next inspection.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed the ice bin to be exposed. Provide a lid for the ice bin behind the bar.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
1). Observed the ice deflector shield to be soiled with what appears to be slime and mold.
2). Observed the soda gun nozzle holder to be soiled with what appears to be mold. 
Clean the food contact surfaces above.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1) Observed the men's restroom urinal needs to be recaulked to the wall. 2) Observed the women's restroom sink needs recaulked to the wall.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
REPEAT X1 - Observed mold growth in drain basin. Clean drain and replace grate.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Acoustic ceiling tiles in bar and restrooms. At next remodel, replace with smooth tiles.
750-1210a Walls and ceilings shall be smooth, durable, non-absorbant and maintained in good repair.
